note: Three images: a cover and one per section opener. The closing page deliberately has none. The corpus reuses the cover field without the photograph for a closing, and a fourth image would be the point at which a discipline becomes a mood board. Subjects are physical and single because the direction token asks for that; none of them depicts data, because photography in the sampled corpus carries data on none of the 16 pages it appears on.

items.subject: A wide shallow metal tray holding dried beans spread unevenly across it, heaped thickly toward one end and thinning to a scatter at the other, shot from directly above
items.alt: Dried beans spread unevenly across a shallow tray, heaped at one end and thinning to a scatter at the other.

items.subject: A single steel measuring tape uncoiled in one long unbroken run across an empty seamless surface, running out of the frame at both ends
items.alt: A steel measuring tape uncoiled in one long run across an empty surface, leaving the frame at both ends.
